description:
Generates a ready-to-deploy cookie consent banner embed snippet tailored to a target web framework or CMS ('html', 'react', 'nextjs', 'wordpress', 'webflow', 'shopify') with Google Consent Mode v2 default 'denied' initialization.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'get_cookie_banner_script' when integrating into a CMS (WordPress PHP hook, Webflow head embed, Shopify theme.liquid) or standard React/Next.js/HTML app. Call 'get_consent_banner_code' instead if you need Vue 3 support, explicit selection between 'v2_basic' (blocking) vs 'v2_advanced' (cookieless pings) GCM v2 modes, or consent update event listeners. Call 'configure_cookie_banner' beforehand to customize banner styling.

Preconditions & side effects: 'siteId' must exist in the active registry. Read-only code generation—does not mutate site state.

Returns: JSON object with 'success', 'siteId', 'site_name', 'framework', 'embed_code', 'gcm_default_state', and 'instructions' (or 'success: false' and 'error' if not found).

framework.description: Target frontend framework or CMS platform for code generation.

siteId.description: Registered site UUID or exact registered URL.

name: get_cookie_banner_script

outputSchema.description: Framework-tailored cookie banner embed snippet and default GCM v2 state.

available_sites.description: Registered sites returned when siteId does not match.

items.description: Summary entry for a registered monitored website.

embed_code.description: Framework-specific banner and GCM v2 initialization code.

error.description: Error message if siteId or framework is invalid.

framework.description: Framework or CMS format used to render the snippet.

gcm_default_state.description: Google Consent Mode v2 default signal values reflected in the snippet.

instructions.description: Deployment placement instructions for the chosen framework.

site_name.description: Display name of the target site.

success.description: True if snippet generation succeeded; false otherwise.

title: Get Framework Cookie Banner Embed Script
